name: HangMan With A Twist
author: Unity Play
description: This project took much longer than I expected. But it has taught me a lot of things! Like how important code structure and naming is(apparently I didn't know that 1.5 months ago, and that resulted in me making my life harder) and planning, of course. Even though I promised myself I wouldn't work on design during my programming learning process, it has also taught me a lot. I think it came out pretty fun to play! This project was like a playground for me, I didn't have a plan for the game or the code structure. Can't wait to work on more planned projects!
